title: A Neural-Network Approach for the Stability of Loosely-Coupled FSI Simulations in Hemodynamics
summary: The development of accurate and efficient computational methods for fluid-structure interaction (FSI) problems remains an active research area due to its broad engineering and biomedical applications. Partitioned loosely coupled (LC) schemes are attractive for large-scale simulations because of their modularity and low computational cost. However, their applicability is limited by stability issues in high added-mass regimes, where fluid and structure densities are comparable, as in hemodynamics.
